targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: 2026-07-24 (V3-EXQ-786a DV-degeneracy re-adjudication; failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-786a_2026-07-24_dv_degeneracy, superseding failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-786a_2026-07-22). The `weakens` recorded 2026-07-22 is WITHDRAWN and revised to `non_contributory`. 786a's recruitment DV (`1 - spearman(full_horizon_score, first_step_score)`) computes `first_step_score` from `world_seq[:, :1, :]` -- index 0 of the world-state sequence, which is the CURRENT state and therefore IDENTICAL across every candidate before any trajectory diverges. `first` is thus a constant vector (verified: n_unique=1 across all 32 candidates, range exactly 0). Spearman correlation against a constant vector reduces to a comparison between the true ranking and an ARBITRARY stable-sort tie-break ordering -- pure noise. Simulated over 200 draws: mean 1.0173, sd 0.1871; the manifest's actual recruitment_rate (1.01725, per-layout sds 0.149-0.207) matches this simulated noise distribution to five significant figures. 786a's own `candidate_score_range_non_degenerate` readiness gate checked only the FULL-HORIZON score range, never the first-step vector, so the degenerate case passed readiness cleanly and the manifest self-reports `non_degenerate: true`. Same class of defect as V3-EXQ-786's own withdrawn measurement (non-scale-free floor); this is the SIBLING defect in the successor instrument. Consequence: the recorded 'flat response' (recruitment delta mean 0.00435, Cohen's d 0.047) is GUARANTEED by construction regardless of whether an arbitrator exists or differential recruitment occurs -- it cannot discriminate MECH-163 leg (1) either way. MECH-163 leg (1) reverts to EXPERIMENTALLY UNTESTED (matching its pre-786a state: literature-only, 9 supports, 0 experimental entries) pending a non-degenerate re-test. MECH-477's motivating observation ('two pathways without an arbitrator produce a flat response') is correspondingly weakened AS A MOTIVATION for having registered the claim -- but MECH-477 itself is independently supported by the confirmed V3-EXQ-811 autopsy, whose design was BUILT specifically to correct this defect (HABIT_DEPTH=2 instead of the degenerate depth-1 read, plus new readiness gates on the habit vector's range and distinct-value fraction) and which measured a real, non-degenerate, load-bearing recruitment-delta effect (Cohen's d 0.999 ON vs -0.158 OFF). MECH-477 stands on 811's own merits, not on 786a's flawed premise.

learning_extracted: A Spearman correlation against a CONSTANT vector is not merely under-powered or zero-signal -- it produces NOISE with a specific, simulatable distribution (mean ~1.02, sd ~0.19 for K=32 candidates under double-argsort tie-breaking), which can pass a naive 'is it a clean null' visual check.

A readiness gate that checks the FULL-HORIZON score range but not every OTHER vector the DV computes from (here, the first-step vector) can pass cleanly while the DV itself is degenerate -- gate every input to a difference/ratio/correlation statistic, not just the more prominent one.

This is now the SECOND consecutive iteration of this diagnostic (786 -> 786a) found to carry a measurement defect on re-derivation rather than at design time. A THIRD iteration (a non-degenerate leg-1 retest) should budget explicit time to re-derive the DV from first principles against a hand-constructed toy case before trusting a clean-looking manifest.
